recipes.positive_prompt: adult courier in a practical low crouch on a rain-soaked rooftop, both feet and hands readable, low camera angle, balanced silhouette, city lights behind
recipes.negative_prompt: floating feet, crossed legs, broken knees, missing hands, duplicate limbs, distorted perspective
recipes.notes: Keep one knee forward and leave enough ground in frame to validate the stance.

recipes.positive_prompt: adult explorer in a stable low crouch beside a forest trail, full body in frame, weight on the rear leg, hands clear, natural overcast light, documentary camera

recipes.notes: A slight three-quarter camera keeps the crouch readable without foreshortening the legs excessively.
